title: Beast
subtitle: Hank McCoy’s science, self-image, and difficult choices.
intro: Gifted offers a clear modern introduction to Hank’s personal stakes. His solo transformation stories are an important earlier milestone; later team books show increasingly complicated decisions.

origin.label: Michigan State University · Origins collection contents

stories.title: Beast’s transformation
stories.why: Hank’s defining physical transformation and a short early solo stretch.
stories.match: No confirmed collection match in the supplied catalog. New X-Men covers a later transformation, not these original stories.

stories.title: New X-Men: E Is for Extinction & Imperial
stories.why: Hank’s changed appearance and place at the school receive renewed attention within Morrison’s team run.
stories.match: The E Is for Extinction Modern Era Epic covers #114–126. It is a team collection, with Hank among the leads.

stories.title: Gifted
stories.why: The mutant-cure dilemma makes this an accessible Beast-focused team story.
stories.match: The dedicated Gifted collection covers the six core issues. Larger Gifted/Ultimate Collection editions overlap it.

stories.title: X-Men Origins: Beast
stories.why: A concise return to Hank’s early life; published later than the events it retells.
stories.match: X-Men Origins contains the Beast one-shot alongside other character spotlights. Origins II is a separate companion collection.

stories.title: Yesterday’s X-Men
stories.why: A consequential Hank decision brings the original team into the present. A key milestone, not a solo book.
stories.match: Use Vol. 1: Yesterday’s X-Men (#1–5). The larger All-New X-Men Vol. 1 (#1–10) is an overlapping alternative.
